programmes.d: Tombstone, Arizona is in for it: a dauntless woman has decided it's time for reform.
Dr. Edward Wilson attempts to curb an epidemic raging in a Paiute village.
Mary Granger finds herself caught between two miners: one who loves her and one who loves her family's money.
Outlaw Belle Clayton and her gang are more determined than ever to rob a Montana-bound train.
Elias Jackson Baldwin, caught up in the gold frenzy, heads for California in 1853 to seek his fortune.
Legendary lawman Clay Griffin is losing his eyesight and refuses an operation despite Annie's pleading. Johnny Storm and the Murdocks commit robbery which leads to Clay's brother Frank being shot.
Annie doesn't believe the man Lofty arrested for the hold up is the right man. She goes behind Lofty's back to prove he's wrong, which gets her into trouble with Lofty.
Dance Hall singer Lil Benton witnesses a murder. After being threatened by the killer, Lil heads for Diablo hoping she can hide from certain death.
An angry Jim Bowie arrives at a New Orleans newspaper office to protest a satirical poem about him just in time to be accused of murdering the editor.
Jim Bowie suspects an inside leak when, despite U.S. Army protection, he becomes the victim of highwaymen and finds out the General’s son is involved with the holdups.
Jim Bowie almost becomes party to a scheme to cheat the generous supporters of a New Orleans orphanage when he engages several men to organize a lottery to raise funds for the orphanage.
Bowie and his young friend Francois become involved with a gang of river vandals when the river men send Spud to burglarize the home of Francois and his aunt.
A rancher threatens to disinherit his niece unless she stops seeing her boyfriend. When the rancher is found murdered, suspicion falls on her lover.
A young woman who has inherited some property is about to be swindled out of it by a crooked lawyer who has hired an impostor to pretend to be the rightful owner.
Cisco and Pancho witness some strange behavior by a coach driver near the town of Guunison. Suddenly they are accused of attempting to rob the stage.
Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.
Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.
Randall is rooked into advancing half the bounty to a man who promises to lead him to the wanted criminal Shawnee Bill, but Bill may be closer than Randall thinks.
A banker with a consuming thirst for vengeance hires Randall to accompany him to track down the man he believes responsible for his son's death and a bank robbery.
Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.
Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.
Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.
Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.
Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.
When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.
Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.
The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.
A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.
Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.
An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.
An Army-Navy rivalry complicates the transfer of gold from California to Washington, D.C.
In 1847, Lt. Edward Beale tries to promote the use of camels in the Southwest.
Among the first American settlers to California, Olive and Vicki organize a school when the men leave for war.
A bank teller faces accusations of embezzlement and all but two people want him lynched.
Charlie Bates' dream about a hold-up becomes a reality — and he becomes the suspect.
The days of Mark Twain as a newspaper editor in the Comstock mining area are depicted.
A faithful dog travels between towns to help the mail service.
Outraged by a tax on the mines, miners in the small town of Rough and Ready decide to secede from the Union.
The California governor sends a lawman to track down a notorious bandit.
Sitting Bull's war plans come between scout Frank Grouard and his Sioux bride.
William T. Coleman, arriving with the 49ers, is pressured to throw his hat into the political ring.
A jack-of-all-trades man stumbles across a way to improve the water wheel.
Billy Benson's landlady wants either her back rent or a wedding ring!
Wyatt Earp takes steps to protect a prospector from claim jumpers.
A young American pirate falls in love with the woman who saved him from execution.
Businessmen turned ranchers find the career change tougher than imagined after someone steals their cattle.
Jeers change to cheers for a prospector who buys a hearse.
